scope: Settlement/composition/PCD research obligations and overclaim review; no implementation or theorem approval.

caveats.finding: Add concrete pressure cases from DS08 and DS17 when reconciling: interface-level Pending must not be reported as economic completion, and cancellation must retain state/authority for late-created allocations. These instantiate the existing composition and residual-duty requirements.

Gross-to-net optimization must preserve authorized gross legs, counterparty consent, fees and liability evolution. Net conservation is a weaker property. Candidate already requires complete effects; the settlement study supplies a decisive witness.

Deadline checking must distinguish preferred settlement dates, strict ledger-time guards and no-unilateral-exit commitments. Turing incompleteness/PCD cannot create a missing refund right or cooperative exit.

Semantic contracts for replaceable primitives/token adapters must establish effects, consumption and outcome meanings; structural interface membership does not establish them. This fits objective certified extensions and must not become a project allowlist.

evidence_that_would_change_vote: A revised implementation treats recursive proof validity as sufficient for spend uniqueness or cross-chain finality.
The local relation admits Pending/acknowledged outcomes while displaying final delivery or erases late-arrival duties after cancellation.
The supported fragment becomes closed fixture/template admission rather than objective language/proof validity.
Compiler or prover-generated witness checks are substituted for arbitrary accepted-witness soundness.

prior_review.preserved_scope: Original content verified unchanged apart from separator whitespace.

delta_review.assessment: All four additions strengthen the research relation without asserting implemented guarantees. Authenticated completeness prevents hidden omission of settlement liabilities; well-founded histories exclude circular/base-state bootstrapping; migration preserves pending recovery duties; relational privacy is kept separate from one-transition checks.
